input.command: ls -la /workspace/inventory && echo "---" && cat /workspace/inventory/src/inventory/pricing.py && echo "---" && ls -R /workspace/inventory/tests 2>/dev/null | head -50

cd /workspace/inventory && cat tests/conftest.py && echo "--- test_pricing ---" && cat tests/test_pricing.py && echo "--- pyproject ---" && cat pyproject.toml && echo "--- git log ---" && git log --oneline -5
cd /workspace/inventory && cat README.md TODO.md CHANGELOG.md .gitignore && echo "--- gnomon ---" && find .gnomon -type f | head -20
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/config.toml .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo "--- bite check: break SAVE10 rate to 0 ---" && sed -i 's/{"SAVE10": 0.10}/{"SAVE10": 0.00}/' src/inventory/pricing.py && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && sed -i 's/{"SAVE10": 0.00}/{"SAVE10": 0.10}/' src/inventory/pricing.py && echo "--- restored ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && git status --short && git diff --stat

cd /workspace/inventory && grep -n "SAVE10" src/inventory/pricing.py && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from inventory.pricing import apply_coupon
print(apply_coupon(100.0,'SAVE10'), apply_coupon(19.99,'SAVE10'))" && find . -name "__pycache__" -path "*/src/*" | xargs -r ls -la
